item.title: cmds 0.18.0
item.description:
Mac only; no iPhone/iPad release (the Unreleased entry above ships with the next companion release).

Added

  • Menu bar: answer a waiting agent without switching to cmds (#213). Choosing a workspace in the menu bar menu opens a panel under the icon with a live view of the pane's last lines, the agent's numbered choices as buttons (Claude Code, Codex; keys 1–9 pick them), a reply field (Return sends; empty, it presses Return) and Esc / ↑ / ↓ / ⏎ / ⌃C keys. ⌘↩ opens the pane in cmds, ⌘↑ / ⌘↓ go to the other workspaces, Esc or a click elsewhere closes it. Hold ⌥ in the menu to open a workspace in cmds as before; Settings › Menu Bar › Reply from the menu bar turns the panel off.
